title: Ejection + Predictive Cooldown Controller for Regional & Tiered Model Routing
creator: Aisha Rahman
description: Design and implement a tenant-aware ejection controller that combines heuristic triggers (429 spikes, timeouts, elevated error rates, and p95 latency drift) with a lightweight predictive cooldown. The controller will operate at route/tier and region granularity and support: (1) soft ejections (traffic steering to compatible model variants and regional replicas), (2) hard opens (circuit-breaker state with immediate failover to fallback variants), and (3) probation/probing periods before re-admittance. The goal is to reduce noisy flapping, minimize customer-facing errors during regional overloads, and preserve latency SLOs by steering requests proactively to healthy capacity.
acceptance_criteria: Controller computes an ejection score per tenant x route x region every 30s and emits a single ejection_decision metric
Soft ejection path routes >= 80% of affected traffic to fallback variant or adjacent region within 30s of trigger without inducing downstream overload
Hard open (circuit) trips only when composite score exceeds configured threshold for 2 consecutive windows and results in >= 95% reduction in error-rate observed from the affected tenant
Automated probation probes run at an exponential backoff and succeed if 5/10 trial requests meet latency and error thresholds
No increase in overall 95th latency across healthy tenants by more than 3% during canary rollout
Unit, integration, and chaos tests cover 429 flood, backend timeout cascade, regional outage, and noisy neighbor scenarios
Monitoring dashboards and alerts for ejection decisions, false positives, and rollback triggers are created and accessible to SRE and product owners
updates: 2025-03-01: Spike-safe ejection scoring prototype implemented in staging. Uses weighted features: 429_rate (0.35), timeout_rate (0.25), p95_delta (0.25), error_zscore (0.15).

2025-03-03: Design review with PM and SRE — agreed to tenant-weighted hysteresis and deterministic cooldown decay to avoid tenant starvation. Action: add telemetry-backed baseline per tenant for p95_delta.
2025-03-05: Integration note — reuse route policy API for immediate soft-steer; added a new fallback action kind 'variant-steer' to route to quantized/low-cost variants.

2025-03-07: Load test (synthetic 20% traffic spike with elevated 429s) shows soft ejection reduces customer-visible 429s by 68% and keeps overall p95 within target. Observed flapping when baseline variance high for small tenants; planning to add minimum-event threshold and minimum-ejection-duration.
2025-03-09: Security review checklist completed; no user data exfiltration risk. Confirmed routing decisions logged with tenant-id and redacted traces for auditability.
2025-03-11: PR opened for controller implementation and route API changes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/9124. Seeking eng and SRE approvals.
2025-03-12: Can be toggled via runtime flags: 'controller.v1.enabled' and 'controller.v1.soft_only'. Default off for all customers. Plan: enable for internal tenants in canary week 1.
